captures.blocker-repros: Native check-only deploys with the row @IsTest class run inside the deploy; named route only. Rows PA01-PA06 and PB01-PB07.
captures.area-M1: Native anonymous (exception transport) and named @IsTest (tagged terminal assertion) captures. Rows I01-I03, I101-I103, S16 and S116.
captures.b41-h1: Native check-only deploys with the row @IsTest class run inside the deploy, and executeAnonymous rows (ids ending -A) with a tagged terminal assertion. Rows H1K1*, H1K2* and H1SI*.
captures.b41-h1-anon: Native executeAnonymous rows (ids H1X*-A) with a tagged terminal assertion: anonymous twins of PA01/PA03/PA04 (casts), PB05-PB07 (RecordType.SObjectType) and H1K2T1/H1K2T2 (QueryLocator returns), with their rejection and boundary rows. H1XC1O-A also deploys one top-level org class (orgClasses) before the block runs.
captures.b41-h1-test: Native check-only deploys with the row @IsTest class run inside the deploy (ids H1TX*, H1TB*) and executeAnonymous rows (H1TB*-A), each with a tagged terminal assertion: the @IsTest twins of the H1X*-A rows that widened the cast, token, QueryLocator-return and Iterator<String> rules, and the Iterator cast boundaries on both routes.

normalization: Sources are the deployed bytes. Only the terminal observation transport is replaced for local execution. PB07 drops the deploy-only dependent-class line.

absentRoutes.reason: The blocker repro rows were captured only as named check-only deploys with their @IsTest class. No anonymous capture exists for them.
